violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee Line cooks/preparers did not wash hands as necessary. No soap at front handwashing sink, to properly wash hands.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. All wiping cloths need to be stored in sanitizer solution when not in use. Several wiping cloths found on prep counters.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Prep line coolers need cleaned of food debris inside storage area.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory in front by line prep area was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Floors need cleaned of old dirt.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mops need to be hung up to allow for drying, when not in use.
Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooling process to be 140F to 70F in 2 hours Then 70F to 41F in 4 Hours.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food * was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. Large pots closest to the door in Walk in cooler have discard dates of 3/22/26 that have not been discarded.
Water Supply. — --Hot water generation was not sufficient to meet the peak demands throughout the food establishment. No hot water at time of inspection for Bathrooms or Handsinks.
Backflow prevention. — --Backflow prevention device has not been installed or maintained on Rinse wand at 4-comp sink as required. Wand hangs below water level in sink.
